Refinery.reason: Pakistan pursuing US EXIM financing for refinery upgrades; talks ongoing, no signed deal yet

Oil & Gas Exploration.reason: Crude prices elevated (~4% surge) on Iran tension lifts E&P wellhead revenue; easing on diplomacy hopes

Islamic Banking.reason: Private sector credit offtake reported weak, pressures bank loan growth; headline-only sourcing

Cement/Conglomerate.reason: DGKC signed solar+BESS deal cutting energy costs; single-name signal for the sector

Power Generation.reason: NEPRA tribunal cut KE tariff to Rs32.37/unit and legislators pressed DISCOs on losses/theft

Fertilizer.reason: Cotton seed germination heat-stress story has no direct fertilizer-demand mechanism

Textile/Synthetic Fibre.reason: Rising mercury reported hurting cotton seed germination in Punjab, a raw-material risk; headline-only

Logistics/Transport.reason: Container crisis reported hitting essential goods supply chain, an operational disruption

news_codex_ratings.json.review_mode: Scheduled cloud dual-review; independent Codex desk
limitations: Confidence values are subjective evidence confidence, not return probabilities. News remains unweighted in the trading score.
The latest committed raw feed was fresh at review time and the Thursday PSX session was live under the repository calendar. EXCHANGE_HOLIDAYS is empty and SESSION_OVERRIDES is empty.

No material new or materially changed tracked-company or tracked-sector story was verified since the 10:48 PKT Codex review. Existing current-session ratings are carried forward unchanged from verified story history; absence of a new reviewed story is not treated as Neutral.

A fresh Mettis refinery headline says Pakistan is set to sign the upgrade deals, but the linked body is inaccessible and its raw timestamp is later than this review time if interpreted as UTC. It does not verify that the ceremony completed, so the existing non-score-bearing refinery implementation view is not upgraded.

KEL.reason: NEPRA's notified FY24-FY30 base tariff is 19% below the original determination, the tribunal rejected KE's appeal, and KE says the outcome has a substantial adverse impact and is financially unsustainable. Higher-court remedies remain possible.
KEL.relevance: Direct link: KEL is K-Electric Limited, the regulated utility affected by the MYT decision.

NML.reason: NML's 20MW solar and 35MWh battery project can reduce purchased-power exposure and improve reliability from March 2027. The separate Rs2.048bn dairy-stake sale is directionally unresolved because carrying value and use of proceeds are undisclosed.
NML.relevance: Direct link: NML is Nishat Mills Limited, the company signing the energy project and selling the dairy stake.

DGKC.reason: DGKC signed for a 25MW solar plant and 10MWh battery system at its Dera Ghazi Khan cement plant, with generation expected in March 2027. The project should lower purchased-power exposure, but capex and savings are not quantified.
DGKC.relevance: Direct link: DGKC is D.G. Khan Cement Company Limited and the project is at its cement plant.

OGDC.reason: Brent rebounded 3.86% to settle at $103.08 and was still $102.13 early Thursday, reversing the prior sub-$100 move and restoring a near-term crude-price tailwind. Diplomacy and inventory news keep confidence moderate.
OGDC.relevance: Sector link: Oil & Gas Exploration; OGDC is a PSX-listed hydrocarbon producer.

PPL.reason: Brent rebounded 3.86% to settle at $103.08 and was still $102.13 early Thursday, reversing the prior sub-$100 move and restoring a near-term crude-price tailwind. Diplomacy and inventory news keep confidence moderate.
PPL.relevance: Sector link: Oil & Gas Exploration; PPL is a PSX-listed hydrocarbon producer.

MARI.reason: Brent's rebound above $100 is positive for the oil-linked portion of MARI's hydrocarbon exposure, but MARI is not a pure crude-price proxy and the oil move remains volatile, so the company-level inference is weaker.
MARI.relevance: Sector link: Oil & Gas Exploration; MARI is a PSX-listed hydrocarbon producer.

Oil Marketing.reason: Petrol fell Rs1.93 per litre and HSD Rs4.21 for September 24, but the report gives no evidence of a changed OMC margin structure and does not quantify inventory or volume effects.
Oil Marketing.relevance: Sector link: Oil Marketing, including PSO.
